notes: American Dynamics = Illustra line (Sensormatic/Tyco/Johnson Controls). Path names differ by product generation, all confirmed against Tyco/JCI official manuals: (1) Illustra 600/610 use /primarystream + /secondarystream (+ /audio); note this older generation defaults its stream ports to 7777-7781, but standard/default RTSP is 554 and paths are the load-bearing part. (2) Illustra Pro / Standard HD use /ufirststream + /usecondstream on default port 554. (3) Illustra Essentials is a Dahua OEM and uses the Dahua path /cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=<0|1>. Session/stream names are configurable in the camera Web-UI (Setup > Network > RTSP/RTP). Two leads (/primarystream, /ufirststream) directly match official docs and are confirmed; the .sdp / ch0_0.h264 / /Video leads are contamination.
